SessionStep helper: attempt-local execution and settlement
|
|-- Captured service references (shared dependencies, not owned services)
|   `-- Bus / LLMClient / Snapshot / ToolOutput
`-- attempt() Effect scope
    |-- pendingStartSnapshot: scoped capture fiber overlaps provider request
    |-- Event publisher (createLLMEventPublisher)
    |   |-- Step record: started/output/failure/finish and continuation facts
    |   |-- Tool-state Map: called, settled, providerExecuted, progress, input
    |   |-- Text/reasoning fragments: ordinals, buffers and delta-flush fibers
    |   `-- -> Bus: text/reasoning/tool/step events update durable projections
    |-- toolRuns array: one record per locally executed call
    |   `-- call + scoped execution fiber + cooperative Cancel gate
    |-- Provider stream consumer -> LLMClient.stream(prepared request/options)
    |   |-- Await start snapshot before first publication
    |   |-- Publish each event; preserve per-source order, no shared writer queue
    |   |-- Local Tool.Called commits BEFORE forking execution
    |   |   |-- -> prepared.executeTool -> selected Tool snapshot.execute
    |   |   |   `-- Registry hooks/permissions; declines stay control failures
    |   |   `-- -> ToolOutput.truncate -> publisher.toolExecution
    |   |-- Provider-executed calls publish without a local execution fiber
    |   `-- Consume through stream end, not just finish; ensure publisher flush
    `-- Settlement (uninterruptible final publication; waits remain interruptible)
        |-- Await all local tool fibers; classify declines, defects, interrupts
        |-- Stop policy
        |   |-- User stop: signal tools awaiting Cancel; interrupt other tools
        |   |   `-- Up to 5 seconds to settle; interrupt remaining fibers
        |   `-- Teardown: interrupt all tools
        |-- Prepared daemon handoff, non-user interrupt, no declines
        |   `-- Leave calls/step unsettled for restart takeover; no step end
        |-- Before output: may return Compacted, RecoverFull or Retry
        |   `-- -> Runner-supplied overflow and retry callbacks
        |-- Settle failed/missing tools and assistant failures
        |-- -> Snapshot.capture/files + SessionUsage.record
        |   `-- -> Bus: final Step.Ended or failure with usage/snapshots/files
        `-- Return Outcome or propagate failure/interruption to runStep
